// diagnostic E2720

Jet.GrammarAmbiguous

This grammar choice is ambiguous

What

This grammar choice is ambiguous

Why

A generated parser picks a way by the next three tokens at most, with no backtracking, so two ways that can begin alike leave it no choice.

Fix

Factor the shared start out of the alternatives, or write operators in the operator form.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.GrammarAmbiguous: Tests/UI/grammar_ambiguous.stderr.

Error: Jet.GrammarAmbiguous: In `command`, alternatives 1 and 2 of this choice can both begin with "set" "the" "value": the parser cannot choose between these within 3 tokens
  --> Tests/UI/grammar_ambiguous.jet:6:15
    |
  6 |     command : 'set' 'the' 'value' to=NAME # Name
    |               ^
 Why: A generated parser picks a way by the next three tokens at most, with no backtracking, so two ways that can begin alike leave it no choice
 Fix: Factor the shared start out of the alternatives, or write operators in the operator form
